lessons: Prioritize classic tantrik and paranormal investigator lore: Taranath Tantrik and ritual-based themes achieved the highest watch percentages (14% to 15.1%).
Familiar everyday public settings (empty classrooms, metro stations) hook viewers better than abstract curses, driving higher initial view counts.
First-person real-life horror ('sotti' tag) drives peak views (up to 8 views), outperforming detached two-part fictional setups.
Single-part or complete standalone tales retain attention far better than multi-part series (part 2 drops sharply to 0-1 views).
Keep compilation formats or 90+ minute long videos on hold until baseline traction improves, as their watch percentage collapses to near zero (0.2%).
titles: Titles grounding the horror in real, identifiable places (e.g., 'কামালপুর জমিদার বাড়ি', 'টালিগঞ্জের শেষ মেট্রো') attract significantly more clicks than generic curse tropes.
Adding 'সত্য ঘটনা অবলম্বনে' (Based on true events) reliably boosts click-through and tops overall views.
Shorter, atmospheric titles perform better than cluttered serial headers with excessive episode numbering and sub-tags.
